# Apple Business Verification Evidence Log — Bed Bugs & Beyond

Status: preparation only; no Apple account or listing action recorded
Last updated: 2026-08-03
Related: Issue #112

## Purpose

Record non-secret evidence for Apple Business claim, verification, public place-card review, and action-link testing. This log must never contain passwords, MFA codes, session tokens, government identifiers, license images, tax records, or verification-document contents.

## Service-claim review

- [ ] Termite service is not represented as currently available.
- [ ] Wildlife removal is not represented as offered.
- [ ] Whole-home bed bug heat treatment is not represented as offered.
- [ ] Bed bug service accurately emphasizes targeted furniture/item and specific-area treatment.
- [ ] Fumigation appears only as an active service with accurate safety limits.
- [ ] No unsupported guarantee, exact savings, fixed price, or one-visit promise appears.

## Completion rule

Apple Business is not considered connected merely because an account exists or a claim was submitted. Completion requires verified ownership, accurate public fields, a reviewed place card, tested approved actions, public identifiers recorded without secrets, and a documented revocation path.
